local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RS = game:GetService("RunService")

local RF = game:GetService("ReplicatedFirst")
local base = require(RF:WaitForChild("Classes"):WaitForChild("RacketHandler"):WaitForChild("Moves"):WaitForChild("RacketMoveBase"))

local size = 28

if getgenv().Hitbox_Expander then getgenv().Hitbox_Expander() end

local old = getgenv().DidHit or base.DidHit
getgenv().DidHit = old

local ball = Instance.new("Part")
ball.Name = "hitbox"
ball.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
ball.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1) * (size * 2)
ball.Transparency = 0.8
ball.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField
ball.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)
ball.Anchored = true
ball.CanCollide = false
ball.CanQuery = false
ball.CanTouch = false
ball.CastShadow = false
ball.Parent = workspace

local con
con = RS.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	local char = Players.LocalPlayer.Character
	if char then
		local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if hrp then
			ball.CFrame = hrp.CFrame
			return
		end
	end
	ball.CFrame = CFrame.new(0, -10000, 0)
end)

base.DidHit = function(self, pos, radius)
	return old(self, pos, size)
end

getgenv().Hitbox_Expander = function()
	if con then
		con:Disconnect()
		con = nil
	end
	if ball then
		ball:Destroy()
	end
	base.DidHit = old
	getgenv().Hitbox_Expander = nil
end

scripts.author: Flamup17

scripts.code:
-- !!!!!!!!!!   READ ME   !!!!!!!!!!
--Click tickets bottom left of your screen, and walk to elevator.
--click Floor 7 then Click "M" to unlock mouse and then you can execute the script
--First TP To Brazier and take the torch.

loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EdgeIY/infiniteyield/master/source", true))()


local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

--// SETTINGS
local espEnabled = false
local trackedPumpkins = {}
local pumpkinCache = {}
local tpCycle = {}
local tpIndex = 0
local tpCycleSize = 4

--// GUI
local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "PumpkinFinderGUI"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
screenGui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local main = Instance.new("Frame")
main.Name = "Main"
main.Size = UDim2.new(0, 250, 0, 255)
main.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -125, 0.5, -107)
main.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 35)
main.BorderSizePixel = 0
main.Active = true
main.Draggable = true
main.Parent = screenGui

local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
corner.Parent = main

local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 35)
title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 0)
title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
title.Text = "Pumpkin Finder"
title.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
title.TextSize = 18
title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
title.Parent = main

local closeButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
closeButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 30, 0, 28)
closeButton.Position = UDim2.new(1, -34, 0, 4)
closeButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 55, 55)
closeButton.Text = "X"
closeButton.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
closeButton.TextSize = 15
closeButton.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
closeButton.Parent = main

local function makeButton(text, position, color)
    local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
    button.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 40)
    button.Position = position
    button.BackgroundColor3 = color
    button.BorderSizePixel = 0
    button.Text = text
    button.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    button.TextSize = 14
    button.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    button.Parent = main

    local buttonCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    buttonCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
    buttonCorner.Parent = button

    return button
end

local espButton = makeButton(
    "Pumpkin ESP: OFF",
    UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 45),
    Color3.fromRGB(65, 65, 75)
)

local tpButton = makeButton(
    "TP to Pumpkin (0/4)",
    UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 95),
    Color3.fromRGB(190, 100, 35)
)

--// BRAZIER BUTTON
local brazierButton = makeButton(
    "TP to Brazier",
    UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 145),
    Color3.fromRGB(120, 75, 160)
)

--// ELEVATOR BUTTON
local elevatorButton = makeButton(
    "TP to Elevator",
    UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 195),
    Color3.fromRGB(55, 125, 160)
)

--// CHARACTER
local function getRoot()
    local character = player.Character
    if not character then
        return nil
    end

    return character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

--// CHECK PUMPKIN TRANSPARENCY
local function isPumpkinVisible(pumpkin)
    if pumpkin:IsA("BasePart") then
        return pumpkin.Transparency == 0
    end

    if pumpkin:IsA("Model") then
        for _, part in ipairs(pumpkin:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Transparency == 0 then
                return true
            end
        end
    end

    return false
end

--// SEARCH FOR VISIBLE PUMPKINS
local function getPumpkins()
    local pumpkins = {}
    local seen = {}

    for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("Model") and obj.Name == "Model" then
            for _, child in ipairs(obj:GetDescendants()) do
                if child.Name == "Pumpkin"
                    and (child:IsA("Model") or child:IsA("BasePart"))
                    and not seen[child]
                    and isPumpkinVisible(child) then

                    seen[child] = true
                    table.insert(pumpkins, child)
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return pumpkins
end

local function getObjectPosition(obj)
    if not obj then
        return nil
    end

    if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
        return obj.Position
    elseif obj:IsA("Model") then
        return obj:GetPivot().Position
    end

    return nil
end

local function findTargetInModels(targetName)
    for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("Model") and obj.Name == "Model" then
            for _, child in ipairs(obj:GetDescendants()) do
                if child.Name == targetName
                    and (child:IsA("Model") or child:IsA("BasePart")) then

                    return child
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return nil
end

local brazierTarget = findTargetInModels("Brazier")

local elevatorTarget = nil

for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
    if obj.Name == "MazeElevatorExit"
        and (obj:IsA("Model") or obj:IsA("BasePart")) then

        elevatorTarget = obj
        break
    end
end

--// REMOVE ESP
local function removeEsp(obj)
    local data = trackedPumpkins[obj]
    if not data then
        return
    end

    if data.highlight then
        data.highlight:Destroy()
    end

    if data.label then
        data.label:Destroy()
    end

    trackedPumpkins[obj] = nil
end

local function clearEsp()
    for obj in pairs(trackedPumpkins) do
        removeEsp(obj)
    end
end

--// CREATE ESP
local function addEsp(obj)
    if not espEnabled or trackedPumpkins[obj] then
        return
    end

    local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
    highlight.Name = "PumpkinESPHighlight"
    highlight.Adornee = obj
    highlight.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 145, 0)
    highlight.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 235, 100)
    highlight.FillTransparency = 0.45
    highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
    highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
    highlight.Parent = screenGui

    local label = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
    label.Name = "PumpkinESPLabel"
    label.Adornee = obj
    label.Size = UDim2.new(0, 120, 0, 30)
    label.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
    label.AlwaysOnTop = true
    label.Parent = screenGui

    local text = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    text.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    text.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    text.Text = "PUMPKIN"
    text.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 0)
    text.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
    text.TextScaled = true
    text.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    text.Parent = label

    trackedPumpkins[obj] = {
        highlight = highlight,
        label = label
    }
end

--// ESP TOGGLE
espButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    espEnabled = not espEnabled

    if espEnabled then
        espButton.Text = "Pumpkin ESP: ON"
        espButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 145, 70)

        -- Search once when ESP is enabled.
        pumpkinCache = getPumpkins()

        for _, pumpkin in ipairs(pumpkinCache) do
            if pumpkin:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) then
                addEsp(pumpkin)
            end
        end
    else
        espButton.Text = "Pumpkin ESP: OFF"
        espButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(65, 65, 75)

        clearEsp()
        pumpkinCache = {}
    end
end)

--// FIND CLOSEST UNVISITED PUMPKIN
local function getClosestPumpkin(excluded)
    local root = getRoot()
    if not root then
        return nil
    end

    local closest = nil
    local closestDistance = math.huge

    for _, pumpkin in ipairs(pumpkinCache) do
        if not excluded[pumpkin]
            and pumpkin:IsDescendantOf(Workspace)
            and isPumpkinVisible(pumpkin) then

            local position = getObjectPosition(pumpkin)

            if position then
                local distance = (root.Position - position).Magnitude

                if distance < closestDistance then
                    closestDistance = distance
                    closest = pumpkin
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return closest
end

--// TP TO PUMPKIN: 0/4 -> 1/4 -> 2/4 -> 3/4 -> 4/4
tpButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local root = getRoot()
    if not root then
        return
    end

    -- Search only if the cache is empty.
    if #pumpkinCache == 0 then
        pumpkinCache = getPumpkins()
    end

    -- Start a new cycle after four successful teleports.
    if tpIndex >= tpCycleSize then
        tpCycle = {}
        tpIndex = 0
    end

    -- Remove pumpkins that no longer exist.
    for pumpkin in pairs(tpCycle) do
        if not pumpkin:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) then
            tpCycle[pumpkin] = nil
        end
    end

    local target = getClosestPumpkin(tpCycle)

    if not target then
        tpButton.Text = "No new pumpkins found"
        return
    end

    local position = getObjectPosition(target)
    if not position then
        return
    end

    -- Mark the pumpkin as visited.
    tpCycle[target] = true

    -- Teleport four studs above the pumpkin.
    root.CFrame = CFrame.new(position + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0))

    tpIndex += 1
    tpButton.Text = "TP to Pumpkin (" .. tpIndex .. "/4)"
end)

--// TP TO BRAZIER
brazierButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local root = getRoot()

    if not root then
        return
    end

    if not brazierTarget or not brazierTarget:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) then
        brazierButton.Text = "Brazier not found"
        task.wait(1.5)

        if brazierButton.Parent then
            brazierButton.Text = "TP to Brazier"
        end

        return
    end

    local position = getObjectPosition(brazierTarget)

    if not position then
        brazierButton.Text = "Invalid Brazier position"
        task.wait(1.5)

        if brazierButton.Parent then
            brazierButton.Text = "TP to Brazier"
        end

        return
    end

    root.CFrame = CFrame.new(position + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0))

    brazierButton.Text = "Teleported!"
    task.wait(1.5)

    if brazierButton.Parent then
        brazierButton.Text = "TP to Brazier"
    end
end)

--// TP TO ELEVATOR
elevatorButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local root = getRoot()

    if not root then
        return
    end

    if not elevatorTarget or not elevatorTarget:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) then
        elevatorButton.Text = "Elevator not found"
        task.wait(1.5)

        if elevatorButton.Parent then
            elevatorButton.Text = "TP to Elevator"
        end

        return
    end

    local position = getObjectPosition(elevatorTarget)

    if not position then
        elevatorButton.Text = "Invalid Elevator position"
        task.wait(1.5)

        if elevatorButton.Parent then
            elevatorButton.Text = "TP to Elevator"
        end

        return
    end

    root.CFrame = CFrame.new(position + Vector3.new(-15, 4, 0))

    elevatorButton.Text = "Teleported!"
    task.wait(1.5)

    if elevatorButton.Parent then
        elevatorButton.Text = "TP to Elevator"
    end
end)

--// CLOSE BUTTON
closeButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    espEnabled = false
    clearEsp()
    screenGui:Destroy()
end)
